summary.text: Elizabeth Moro is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 160, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Craig Williams.
A small business owner and author, she ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Elizabeth Moro was born in Port Huron, Michigan, and earned a high school diploma from Holy Cross High School and a bachelor's degree from Western Michigan University's Lee Honors College in 1995.
Her career experience includes owning Centreville Place: Café + Market, and she holds a broker's license and engages in real estate activities in Pennsylvania and Delaware.
She wrote The Civil Graces Project and has been associated with the National Association of Realtors and the Delaware Restaurant Association.
Moro was the Democratic nominee for District 160 in 2024 and lost to Williams, 48.1% to 51.7%.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
In her 2026 Ballotpedia survey response, she described herself as a mom, small business owner, author and founder of Neighbors for Crebilly.
She said her campaign priorities include rising costs for families, defending voting and reproductive rights, and public education.
